title: HtmlDatalist
responsibility: Renders the native datalist element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlDatalist.attributes
inputs.description: Native datalist attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlDatalist.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native datalist element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlDatalist
outputs.description: The actual native datalist element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
